_comment: The effects every conforming host offers. What a package may do is checked against these rather than against a list inside the compiler — a second host with an effect of its own publishes its own document instead of patching ours.

A disclosure cannot be undone, which is why an action performs at most one and why the compiler orders it last in a batch. That fact is here rather than in the compiler, so a host cannot be given a reversible one by accident.
